title: The *arr suite: your media on autopilot

intro.headline: Your media library, on autopilot.
intro.subhead: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr — six tools that turn manual downloading into a set-and-forget pipeline.

outro.headline: Never organize a download folder again.
outro.subhead: Run the *arr stack with Docker and let it do the boring work. Which one are you starting with — Sonarr or Radarr?
